parsed.reason: Description A identifies stale heap entries left by discard()/add() causing early expiry, eviction, and purge() popping live items, with pop() dropping an item when any heap entry for it is popped. Description B identifies the specific pop() defect: it removes a live re-added item when it pops that item's stale heap entry, returning it as oldest. Both name the same root cause (pop() not checking whether the popped heap entry is current) at the same place, with A covering additional consequences.
